args.desc: The numerator of the share the winner must exceed

returns.desc: The identifier of the new session

args.desc: The zero-based index of the chosen option

methods.desc: Seal the final amounts; no final write is possible afterwards.

methods.desc: Record whether an option has won a session whose final amounts are sealed.
